liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **SHE'S ON THE ROAD AGAIN** (1 review): Jerry sings lead; the band's vocal harmonies are still developing [6]
- **I KNOW YOU RIDER** (1 review): Folkier arrangement than later ones, though not far from the live Europe 72 versions [6]
- **HEY LITTLE ONE** (1 review): Reportedly played only three times, and only this show matches all the other tracks [7]
- **KING BEE** (1 review): Pig plays plenty of harmonica, especially on this song [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **SHE'S ON THE ROAD AGAIN**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [9]
- **HEY LITTLE ONE**: rare: 7 archived performances [9]
- **STEALIN'**: rare: 14 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1966-xx-xx.sbd.gans.2372.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 8 songs; 35 min; rated 4.43/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording early in the band's career but good-sounding, though its source dates are unclear; Sound is excellent, in the reviewer's view better than many 1990s soundboards, despite unknown recording dates [2][3]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: GDH [1]
- Reviewer, citing deadlists, thinks these eight songs are the end of the 12 March 1966 Danish Center show in Los Angeles [5]
- Reviewer says GD Database matches these tracks to the 25 February 1966 show at the Cinema Theatre, Los Angeles [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1966-xx-xx.sbd.gans.2372.shnf**: source: SBD [1]
